What are the types of inheritance in Python?

Supplied answer
Single (one parent), Multilevel (A to B to C), Multiple (a class inheriting from two or more parents),
Hierarchical (many children from one parent) and Hybrid (a mix). With multiple inheritance Python
decides which method to use via the MRO (Method Resolution Order), which you can see with
ClassName.__mro__.
